.. start installation

``domdf_python_tools`` can be installed from PyPI or Anaconda.

To install with ``pip``:

.. code-block:: bash

	$ python -m pip install domdf-python-tools

To install with ``conda``:

.. code-block:: bash

	$ conda install -c conda-forge domdf-python-tools

.. end installation
